verification.runtime_check: Started uvicorn main:app from backend/ on port 8765 and drove it with curl as in the criteria above. This created the real logs.db and 2 PNGs in uploads/. I deleted exactly those (logs.db, 5cdc3a64...png, d10828a4...png) and stopped the server (confirmed port closed). The tree was diffed against a snapshot taken before the run: identical. The oversize check used a 5 MiB+10 byte photo, which hit the 413 "photo exceeds 5 MiB" path rather than the whole-body middleware.
verification.self_critique: Did not run create_app with temp paths from a script outside the project, or the tests from another cwd. The cwd-independence is shown only by the constant-based path and a run from backend/. The body-limit middleware 413 was not exercised over HTTP on the real server. Criterion 3 "byte-identical rest" was checked by reading, not by diff. The first pkill attempt failed (not installed), so the server stayed up briefly until killed another way; no effect on the results.
